description: This file defines the IStateMachineManager interface for managing state machines within Orleans.journaling, including initialization, registration, retrieval, persistence, and deletion operations.

classes.name: IStateMachineManager
classes.description: Interface for managing state machines, allowing initialization, registration, retrieval, persistence, and deletion of state machine states.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the state machine manager, possibly preparing resources.

methods.name: RegisterStateMachine
methods.description: Registers a new state machine instance with a given name.

methods.name: TryGetStateMachine
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a registered state machine by name, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Persists any changes to state, preparing logs or durable storage.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Removes persistent state, effectively resetting the state machine manager.
